# available, either in this job's local-build repo or already
# published) before nginx builds. One name per line.

# those still declare the actual package name + version. This file is
# only used by ci/resolve-build-order.sh (build ORDER + auto-pull-in)
# and implicitly relied on by ci/verify-build-deps.sh's check.
